title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Senior individual contributor leading design and delivery of large, distributed systems. Owns reliability, mentors engineers, and makes pragmatic trade-offs under ambiguity.
must_have: Distributed systems architecture & design (scale, consistency, failure modes)
Deep expertise in at least one of: Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Java
Leading design reviews / architecture decisions on large systems
Experience owning production reliability (SLOs, incident response)
